Summary: Across five reasoning task families and three tool-augmented task families, agentic workflows consume a mean 4.33× higher energy per successful goal compared to equivalent linear baselines (888.1 J vs 205.3 J). This overhead is driven by orchestration structure, including retries, intermediate planning, and other factors. The energy per successful goal (EpG) is calculated as the sum of energy across all attempts in a workflow divided by the number of successful workflows. When failures occur, energy consumption amplifies further due to retries.
